photo-black.$description: Photo Black — Body text, filled buttons, dark section backgrounds, nav text, borders, icon strokes — the dominant structural color across all surfaces

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, hero background, footer background, text on dark surfaces, nav fill — the primary light surface

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Subtle alternate section backgrounds, hairline washes — barely-there surface differentiation

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, footer link text, muted labels — the first step down from body black

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, lighter secondary labels, disabled-adjacent text

silver.$description: Silver — Borders on ghost/outline buttons, subtle dividers, placeholder text

steel.$description: Steel — Mid-gray auxiliary text and borders

amber.$description: Amber — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

goldenrod.$description: Goldenrod — Lighter amber variant for hover states, secondary accent surfaces — same hue family, one step lighter

vsco-gothic.$description: Single custom family used at every size — nav items at 13px tracked to 0.08-0.10em, body at 15-16px, product card titles at 24px, section headings at 36-54px, and hero display at 89-98px with -0.05em tracking. The narrow geometric letterforms with ligatures disabled give every text element a distinctive editorial-gallery feel, even at body sizes.
